statement: The Space Force, one of the six U.S. armed forces, was established on December 20, 2019, when the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020 became law.

corroboratingSources.title: Public Law 116-92, National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020
